requirements.requirement: Run a long-running background worker on node1 as a managed service named inventory-worker.
requirements.summary: The service was enabled and active with a stable main process while its heartbeat advanced. After node1 restarted, systemd automatically started a new worker process and its heartbeat continued advancing.

requirements.requirement: Confine the worker so it can write only inside /var/lib/inventory.
requirements.summary: The running service could write under /var/lib/inventory but was blocked from writing to /etc, /tmp, /run, and /var/tmp, both before and after restart. The live unit also reported ProtectSystem=strict with /var/lib/inventory as its ReadWritePaths exception.

requirements.requirement: Ensure the worker gains no new privileges.
requirements.summary: The live worker process reported NoNewPrivs=1 and empty bounding and ambient capability sets before and after restart; systemd reported NoNewPrivileges=yes.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied with direct runtime evidence. The mandatory node-restart protocol is also complete: the service was healthy before restart, restart was acknowledged, the boot identity changed from 34027437-307c-4f58-bdb2-1fe626bb2d66 to e7476fb1-c63b-4acf-a838-8694853801dd, and the service, heartbeat data, privilege controls, and write confinement recovered. Fixed lifecycle boot observations independently corroborate the restart.
limitations: Write confinement was behaviorally sampled at representative writable locations rather than exhaustively testing every possible filesystem path; the observed systemd policy supplies coherent supporting coverage.

The fixed lifecycle collector does not specifically inventory the inventory-worker unit or its files, so service recovery relies on the direct executor observations; those observations are detailed and consistent.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Creating the account, data directory, executable, and unit and enabling the service were necessary implementation actions (cmd-fb06263d1b0f4805). The bounded confinement probes were necessary evidence and their successful in-scope probe files were removed (cmd-e1875467ab684ab6, cmd-7457a072ed474fa8); blocked probes produced no observed residue. The scheduled reboot was required by the provider-wide restart protocol (cmd-173320ac9f5444c8). Final snapshots show no failed services, added listeners, package damage, or abandoned temporary probe files.
